title: Emit one versioned JSON envelope for query success and failure
preconditions: Use coveredSaga and the real separate-repository query fixture; include supported success operations and a forced stable invalid_argument failure.

steps.action: Query terms, layers, history, slide and overview; decode each response as one JSON value.
steps.expected_result: Every response has the common schema and a nonempty snapshot; real fixture operation table additionally includes data and page on success.

steps.action: Exercise each stable error mapping through the query opener seam.
steps.expected_result: Exactly one error envelope preserves code and retryability with ok=false.

expected_result: Clients can branch on stable envelope fields for successful and failed queries.
